|game_text='''0 side — City In The Clouds'''

Deploy Bespin system and a Cloud City battleground site. May deploy Weather Vane. While this side up, once per turn, may use 1 Force to ▼ a Cloud City battleground. Flip this card if you control two Cloud City battleground sites and occupy Bespin system, and opponent controls no Cloud City sites.

'''7 side — You Truly Belong Here With Us'''

While this side up, once per game, may ▼ Cloud City Celebration. Once during your control phase, may use 2 Force to ▲ an Interrupt. Once per turn, may move your character as a 'react' to a battle or Force drain at a Cloud City site. Flip this card if opponent controls more Cloud City sites than you.
